SELECT P.POST_ID, P.MEMBER_ID, P.UNIV_ID, M.MEMBER_NAME AS AUTHOR_NAME, MD.COMMUNITY_NICKNAME AS AUTHOR_NICKNAME, P.BOARD_ID, BT.BOARD_NAME, P.TITLE, P.VIEW_COUNT, P.REPORT_COUNT, P.IS_BLIND, P.CREATED_AT FROM POST P JOIN MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_ID = P.MEMBER_ID LEFT JOIN MEMBER_DETAIL MD ON MD.MEMBER_ID = P.MEMBER_ID LEFT JOIN BOARD_TYPE BT ON BT.BOARD_ID = P.BOARD_ID
ORDER BY P.REPORT_COUNT DESC, P.CREATED_AT DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT 10 ROWS ONLY

SELECT M.MEMBER_ID, M.UNIV_ID, M.MEMBER_NAME, M.LOGIN_ID, M.ROLE, U.UNIV_NAME, M.STATUS, NVL(PR.REPORTED_POST_COUNT, 0) AS REPORTED_POST_COUNT, NVL(PR.TOTAL_REPORT_COUNT, 0) AS TOTAL_REPORT_COUNT FROM MEMBER M LEFT JOIN UNIVERSITY U ON U.UNIV_ID = M.UNIV_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT MEMBER_ID, COUNT(CASE WHEN REPORT_COUNT > 0 THEN 1 END) AS REPORTED_POST_COUNT, SUM(REPORT_COUNT) AS TOTAL_REPORT_COUNT FROM POST WHERE IS_DELETED = 0 GROUP BY MEMBER_ID ) PR ON PR.MEMBER_ID = M.MEMBER_ID
ORDER BY TOTAL_REPORT_COUNT DESC, M.MEMBER_ID ASC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT 10 ROWS ONLY

SELECT M.MEMBER_ID, M.UNIV_ID, M.MEMBER_NAME, M.LOGIN_ID, M.ROLE, U.UNIV_NAME, M.STATUS, NVL(PR.REPORTED_POST_COUNT, 0) AS REPORTED_POST_COUNT, NVL(PR.TOTAL_REPORT_COUNT, 0) AS TOTAL_REPORT_COUNT FROM MEMBER M LEFT JOIN UNIVERSITY U ON U.UNIV_ID = M.UNIV_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT MEMBER_ID, COUNT(CASE WHEN REPORT_COUNT > 0 THEN 1 END) AS REPORTED_POST_COUNT, SUM(REPORT_COUNT) AS TOTAL_REPORT_COUNT FROM POST WHERE IS_DELETED = 0 GROUP BY MEMBER_ID ) PR ON PR.MEMBER_ID = M.MEMBER_ID WHERE M.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND M.ROLE IN ('STU', 'PROF', 'ALU')
